name: MS-NeRF
definition: Addresses rendering distortion and blurring caused by reflection or refraction (e.g., mirrors) where standard NeRF fails multi-view consistency. Represents the scene by a set of characteristic fields in parallel subspaces.
summary: MS-NeRF renders unbounded scenes with reflections by decomposing the radiance field into parallel sub-spaces integrated via a learned gating mechanism.
